description: Use Social AI to generate website content. Returns blocks for a full page, a single section, or a theme suggestion.

currentBlocks.description: Existing blocks (required for fill-content and full-page edits)

mode.description: full-page: generate a complete page layout | block: generate one section/block | fill-content: update copy in existing blocks | suggest-theme: suggest color/font theme

model.description: Optional model override. Omit this unless the user asks for a specific model; the API picks a provider-compatible default.

prompt.description: What to generate, e.g. "A homepage for a Cape Town law firm"

name: generate_content
